lesson: The system is consistently attempting to fade high-velocity momentum or enter against the primary trend, resulting in 6 consecutive stop-outs during impulsive phases. The reliance on RSI and Bollinger Band overextension is failing to account for sustained Wyckoff-style markdown phases where price ignores traditional oscillators.
adjustment: Implement a 'Trend-Filter' rule that prohibits all counter-trend entries unless a confirmed Wyckoff Spring or localized Change of Character (CHoCH) is identified on the 1h timeframe.
methodology_flag: Trust RSI/Bollinger Band mean-reversion signals less during high-volume directional impulses.
